newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0800 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to 0.10 cent lower. Sell-off in back month contracts at the close seen bringing in additional selling. Firm cash cattle and beef markets should underpin.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to 0.10 cent higher. Market supported by good demand in cash markets and small increase in the in the latest feeder cattle index.
HOGS - 0.10 to 0.20 cent higher. Cash hog markets seen as much as $0.75 per cwt higher and pork product market is also climbing. Follow-through buying also seen as a factor.
PORK BELLIES - 0.20 to 0.25 cent higher. Follow-through buying seen boosting prices. Wednesday's large slaughter could limit gains.
